findings.evidence: The declaration has `{w v : ι → Rˣ}`, while `QuadraticMap.Equivalent` supports different spaces; `squareClass_prod_eq_of_equivalent` at Discriminant.lean:80 must destruct presentations and force `n = m` before it can use this lemma.
findings.fix: State the theorem with separate finite index types `{ι κ}` and derive an index equivalence from the linear isometry (or reindex one standard basis internally) before applying the determinant argument.
findings.issue: `isSquare_prod_mul_prod_of_equivalent` requires both weight families to have type `ι → Rˣ`, so it cannot directly express its documented claim for equivalent diagonal forms on different finite index types.

summary: The reusable determinant lemma is unnecessarily restricted to diagonal forms indexed by the same type, despite `QuadraticMap.Equivalent` naturally comparing different coordinate spaces.
